Body.Content:
Enable multiple addresses for customer accounts and use the appropriate invoice and delivery addresses across project quotations, project contracts, and project invoices. Users can select from existing customer addresses or create new addresses when needed. Selected addresses flow through the project lifecycle and are synchronized between Dataverse and Dynamics 365 Finance

GA date: May CY2027
